items.series: T-PLUS P2 It really happened, on the clock
items.hypothesis: TP-B1 P2: DOCUMENTARY_STORY on the live clock; primary = public views at 48 h.
items.caption:
66 million years ago, an asteroid 10–15 km wide hit Mexico. Its first day, on the clock.
A 200 km crater in minutes; by nightfall ~130 m of rock inside it, sealed by tsunami sand full of charcoal.
